baseline_qualification.oracle: Directed MPFR bounds must round to the same binary64; signaling NaNs separately require a quiet NaN result.
baseline_qualification.abi: Every ARM call verifies R4-R11, SP and bounded stack writes.
baseline_qualification.scope: Saved worst-case corpus; not a totality proof over all binary64 pairs.
known_limitations: The owned 512/1024-bit fallback preserves a final undecided-interval trap; totality is unproved.

hard_instruction_profile.scope: Seeded reservoir of published hard pow inputs in three explicit finite domains. Positive normal bases and bounded logarithm-products keep the composed Qfplib ln/mul/exp comparison meaningful. Actual production/diagnostic ARM and captured ROM execute on separate identical emulator instances. Instruction counts are not physical cycles or timings. This is additional coverage, not a replacement for the 114-group matrix or an all-input proof.

selection: Seeded reservoir from the saved pow.wc corpus; x=1 is excluded so trivial exact answers do not dilute the difficult-input profile. All selected input encodings are recorded.
interpretation: The former 114-group comparison did not contain these hard-input streams. All three additional streams are slower by mean instruction count, so the library speed objective is not achieved.

regression.scope: Actual ROM/flash/SRAM code; mixed counted and uncounted calls must have the same nonzero instruction count as a fresh machine. This guards emulator instrumentation, not hardware timing.

counter_fix.note: Unicorn retained uninstrumented translated code after uncounted calls. Counted calls now flush the complete translation cache. Numeric results were unaffected; the original always-counted profiles replay identically.
